title: Joseph Smith possibly killed by government agents, and the state of Deseret

tellings.quote: Joseph Smith actually may have been assassinated by agents of the government.

plain: Joseph Smith, who founded the Mormon church, 'actually may have been assassinated by agents of the government', according to the analyst Matthew Pines, who links this to Deseret, the name the Mormons gave the state they set up in Utah in the 1840s. Pines tells Michels this without naming a source. If true, the government would have seen Smith's movement as a threat worth killing over.
